verdict.rationale: Railway's own materials say you can connect a repo and have the platform auto-configure the build. It "reads your code and sets the right settings, automatically," and YAML is optional, which covers the core of this story. The support is homepage-level claims only. missing for 10: in-depth docs on build detection (which languages/frameworks are auto-detected, and fallback behavior when detection fails), independent or hands-on confirmation that repo-connect deploys work without manual configuration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can deploy my app by simply connecting my repo without manual build configuration

citations.quote: Connect your repo, Railway handles the rest. Auto-config, instant previews, no new tools to learn.
Railway reads your code and sets the right settings, automatically.
